scope.description: Unreleased implementation snapshot for the numeric array and dtype foundation. No behavior is declared conformant.

implemented_behavior: Numeric inference from Python bool, int, float, and complex values
Rectangular list and tuple inputs, including zero-dimensional and empty inputs
Explicit numeric dtype names, aliases, and built-in Python numeric type objects
C and F output order; K/A order selection for Raptors array inputs
copy=False may reuse a compatible Raptors array
known_limits: Ragged, object, string, structured, datetime, and foreign-buffer inputs are unsupported
K order for non-contiguous inputs has not been checked against NumPy
Only C and F order are accepted
Storage is initialized for Rust safety; returned values are unspecified
Promotion rules have not been checked against the pinned oracle

numeric_dtypes: platform aliases including intp, uintp, int_, uint, long, and ulong; pointer codes n/N and p/P
longdouble and clongdouble where the target exposes an extended representation

unsupported: object, bytes string, Unicode string, void, structured, and subarray dtypes
Foreign memory, buffer protocol, DLPack, and NumPy interoperation
Full NumPy scalar identity and scalar protocol behavior
known_gaps: Casting overflow, invalid casts, warnings, and all NumPy promotion edge cases need reference coverage
Extended precision accepts the numeric inputs currently exposed by the Python API but does not accept arbitrary high-precision Python values
Some advanced-index and non-contiguous reshape sharing cases are unverified
Miri, AddressSanitizer, the full wheel matrix, cross-version/platform differential runs, and release gates remain pending
